title: Research: reduce one complex factory circuit from 87 to 35 operations (no new kappa)
body:
This replaces one 87-operation coordinate-total window in the **raw PR622 complex K-triangle constructor** with 35 operations, preserving its complete ordered eight-register rational map. Updating the literal inverse cleanup saves **104 scalar operations and 652 real-component primitives per raw invocation**, in either orientation. This is a **finite local circuit improvement / research note, with no new κ**.

The five helper and three source registers retain their physical frame paths. Helper count, arbitrary-dirt compensation, paid child histogram, rank mass and phase-edge inventory are unchanged. Exact nonnegative transfer and prefix comparisons cover the main, inverse cleanup and both inverse-transpose words; the full emitted-program prefix does not increase. All coefficient preparation, source reads, halving, signed accumulation and private-work clearing are charged.

Only `research/complex-factory5-resynthesis/` is added. The package contains the exact circuit, finite substitution proof, source pins, bounded search, independent column-oriented local checker, inherited full raw-word replays, deterministic receipt and local sprint claim.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-factory5-resynthesis/verify.py
```

Python 3.11+, standard library, offline. Expected:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_FACTORY5_RESYNTHESIS gates=87->35 saved_with_cleanup=104 columns=716 controls=10
```

The command freshly rebuilds both raw words and checks **all 716 arbitrary input columns in both orientations**, native frames, private clearing, emitted primitive counts and deterministic receipts. It does not import the search implementation. Ten new mathematical controls include exact-map-neutral endpoint growth, endpoint-envelope-neutral prefix growth, cost inflation and missing cleanup; the inherited four controls run on each word.

Validation passed on macOS arm64 with Python **3.14.3** and **3.11.15**, including isolated optimized execution. A minimal committed source archive at `80d4edbc2d53f058787cb5c43bd0fc22c7e7fdff` reproduces the certificate and 1,024-trial search. Relocation to a path with spaces and five package corruption/output-preservation controls pass. The selected-record/source-inventory check and staged whitespace check pass. No full repository suite, cold selected-provider replay, phase lowering, global hosting/invoice, Linux CI or Lean pass is claimed.

### Scope and provenance

- Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`.
- Reviewed PR622 head: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`; PR626 source package: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`. Sixteen exact file pins are checked.
- Assignment seed **33**, drawn from OS randomness, selected block `33 mod 14 = 5`. Search completed 1,024 seeded Gaussian-elimination trials on this one fixed map. No optimality claim.
- PR645 changes the factory's arbitrary-helper-input map and complementary basis; this preserves both. Concurrent #670/#674 simplify different **F2 bit-supplier** circuits. Their related work is credited, with no code dependency. The final overlap snapshot covers 500 open PRs through #680. No pinned coordination issue existed; the completed local claim links the result and certificate.
- Credit: Jeremy Kothe's PR622/Claude Code construction lineage; icekylinx's PR531/425/433/523 scalar and coordinate-total factory; DreamingOfClouds' inherited native/emitted verification; Dugongue's PR514/522 modules and rank-sector work; Chafik Boukhalfa's PR626 packaging; eumemic and the selected-result predecessors. Full notices and attribution are retained.

**This edit is not transported through the later optimized provider recipes.** Those depend on scalar-word/index bindings and require separate reconstruction and full admission. The unchanged child widths provide no new recurrence exponent. All uniform compiler/common-label/mutable-basis, precision/tape, analytic and selected bit assumptions remain inherited. `upstream/` and the selected frontier are untouched.

Prepared for **Alluri (@alluri-ritual)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in research, code, proof analysis, verification and writing. Apache-2.0. No delegated-agent or independent human review is claimed.
